maya: Short proposal to reduce lingering postmortem actions: require a single vetted remediation card per postmortem + tweak IC handoff. Outline below. Feedback?

maya: Remediation card fields (template):
- id: auto
- goal (one line)
- owner (person/team)
- ETA (ISO date)
- verification metric/test
- rollback criteria
- recurrence_flag (yes/no) + signal to watch
- priority (P0/P1/P2)
- status (todo/in-progress/blocked/done)

rachael: love making verification explicit. rule idea: if not done by T+72, owner must set ETA and list blocker. enforce via ops-bot.

priya: ops-bot can create the card automatically for P1/P2 PMs and set a T+72 reminder. I can wire the webhook.

ops-bot: tracker_card created for thread 2322223333, reminder set: T+72.

alexc: on IC rotation: propose 2-week primary + 1-week shadow handoff. shadow expected to join triage and take over if needed. add two-line handoff template.

jamal: for recurrence detection: if same service sees >2 incidents with the same root keyword in 90d, auto-tag threads with "recurrence-check" and spawn a 30m triage invite. keeps patterns visible.

maya: sample minimal timeline: T+0: incident + IC + Impact tags; T+24: triage summary; T+72: remediation card + owners + ETA; T+14d: sprint snapshot; T+30d: recurrence review; T+90d: closure.

rachael: agree. require Impact tags at T+0 (latency/errors/data-loss) and SLO impact on the remediation card.

priya: I'll implement tracker webhook today. ops-bot will post a card link in-thread and ping owners at T+72 and weekly until done.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled -> "T+72 remediation check" for thread 2322223333.

jamal: I'll run a 3-incident pattern sweep next month to validate recurrence thresholds and report back.

alexc: ack on the IC rotation change; will update runbook.

maya: thanks all. next steps: priya wires tracker, alexc updates runbook, jamal runs sweep. we'll review pilot at monthly oncall retro.

ops-bot: reminder closed -> "T+72 remediation check" for thread 2322223333.
